gloss: close to station; near the station

definitions.gloss: close to station; near the station; within walking distance of a train station
definitions.explanation: describes a location, usually a property or business, that is conveniently close to a train or subway station; a key selling point in Japanese real estate

examples.japanese: {駅近|えきちか}の{物件|ぶっけん}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a property close to the station.

examples.japanese: {駅近|えきちか}だと{家賃|やちん}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Rent is expensive for places near the station.

examples.japanese: {駅近|えきちか}で{便利|べんり}な{場所|ばしょ}に{住|す}みたい。
examples.english: I want to live in a convenient location near the station.

notes:
FORMATION:
{駅|えき} (station) + {近|ちか} (near, close) → close to station

ABBREVIATION:
{駅|えき}から{近|ちか}い (close to the station) → abbreviated to {駅近|えきちか}

FUNCTIONS AS:
- Noun: {駅近|えきちか}の{物件|ぶっけん} (property near station)
- No-adjective: {駅近|えきちか}で{便利|べんり} (convenient and near station)

REAL ESTATE CONTEXT:
{駅近|えきちか} is one of the most important criteria in Japanese real estate. Properties within a 5-10 minute walk of a station are highly desirable and command premium prices.

COMMON STANDARDS:
- {徒歩|とほ}5{分|ふん}{以内|いない} (within 5 minutes walk) - considered excellent
- {徒歩|とほ}10{分|ぷん}{以内|いない} (within 10 minutes walk) - good
- {徒歩|とほ}15{分|ふん}{以上|いじょう} (15+ minutes walk) - not considered {駅近|えきちか}

RELATED REAL ESTATE TERMS:
- {駅|えき}{徒歩|とほ}〜{分|ふん} (~ minutes walk from station)
- {駅前|えきまえ} (in front of station)
- {閑静|かんせい}な{住宅街|じゅうたくがい} (quiet residential area)
- {南向|みなみむ}き (south-facing)
